decisive_spans.text: Focal, non-keratinizing invasive squamous cell carcinoma

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states 'Focal, non-keratinizing invasive squamous cell carcinoma' and 'infiltrative process at the base and root of the tongue', which directly supports 'Squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue'. While 'Oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma' is also supported by the same biopsy results, 'Squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue' is more specific given the imaging findings of an 'infiltrative process at the base and root of the tongue'.
